symptom: node stop-hook.mjs hung indefinitely when invoked directly from PowerShell
root_cause: stop-hook.mjs reads JSON payload from stdin (fd 0) via readFileSync(0, 'utf8') and waits for EOF when no stdin pipe is provided
fix: Pipe JSON payload to stdin or use gate-check.mjs --approve for gate verification; added AB-001 antibody

symptom: spawnSync timed out on cold start when child Node script spawned FreeLLMAPI server on port 3001
root_cause: Windows child processes inherited parent stdout/stderr pipe handles, keeping spawnSync open even after child process exited
fix: Spawned FreeLLMAPI via WMI Win32_Process.Create with ShowWindow=0 for zero handle inheritance; added AB-004 antibody

symptom: PowerShell ParserError: Unexpected token '-c' when calling quoted python.exe path
root_cause: Quoted executable path at the beginning of a PowerShell statement requires the '&' call operator
fix: Added AB-002 antibody in pre-tool-rtk.mjs to auto-prepend '& ' to quoted .exe commands in PowerShell

symptom: AI-generated replacement images missed exact camera angle and graphic artwork when prompted from product titles alone
root_cause: Prompt was guessed from title instead of forensic visual extraction from reference image
fix: Built 8-axis visual reverse-prompting in cli-anything-google-vids (prompt from-image) + side-by-side read_file verification; added AB-006 antibody
